children: Uruguay’s unemployment rate edged up to 7.2% in August 2026 from 7.0% in July, marking the first increase since May.
By region, Montevideo recorded a higher unemployment rate than the rest of the country, at 7.3% versus 7.1%.
The gap between men and women persisted, with female unemployment at 8.8%, compared with 5.7% for men.
Unemployment varied significantly by age, reaching 23.4% among young people aged 14 to 24, the group facing the greatest difficulties entering the labor market.
This pattern was similar to that observed in July.
Regarding employment quality, both underemployment (9.1%) and the lack of social security registration (20.8%) remained at levels similar to those recorded in the previous month.

title: Uruguay Jobless Rate Rises in August
